recognize_zh: 白血球數量極多，同一視野裡骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核與分節嗜中性球都有，成熟過程連續且無明顯發育不良，中間可見一顆含橘紅色顆粒的嗜伊紅性球，符合 CML 慢性期的周邊血液像。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a continuous spectrum of granulocytic maturation
Myelocytes predominate: round to oval nuclei, partially condensed chromatin, lilac secondary granules
Metamyelocytes and bands with indented to horseshoe nuclei, plus mature segmented neutrophils
A single eosinophil with orange refractile granules centrally
Blasts not increased; no hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei
Numerous platelets; normocytic normochromic red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at all stages of maturation, predominantly myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. An eosinophil is present, blasts are not increased in this field, and there is no significant granulocytic dysplasia. Platelets are abundant and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Reactive left shift has toxic granulation, Dohle bodies and few myelocytes, without eosinophilia or basophilia.
aCML shows marked dysgranulopoiesis and no basophilia, while maturation here is orderly.
CNL is dominated by mature segmented neutrophils with fewer than 10% circulating immature granulocytes.
